title: Vault Sajni A-Style Solid Spruce Top Electro-Acoustic Mandolin – Tobacco Sunburst, with Bag
desc:
The VAULT-SAJNI A Style Mandolin is crafted for both beginners and pros alike. This very model was used to play the epic hindi hit song SAJNI from Movie Laapataa Ladies.

Featuring a solid spruce top for bright, resonant tone and laminated sapele back and sides for durability, this mandolin delivers a rich acoustic sound, as can be heard in this epic song here. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k3g_WjLCsXM

The technical wood neck and fingerboard with 20 frets ensure smooth playability and comfortable handling.

Designed with an ABS body binding and PPS nut & saddle, the instrument maintains structural integrity while providing excellent tonal clarity. Chrome machine heads make tuning precise and easy. The open-pore finish in Tobacco unburst (TBS) gives it a visually striking look.

Equipped with a built-in magnetic pickup, tone control, and volume control. it is perfect for both acoustic performance and amplified settings. The adjustable wooden bridge and chrome tailpiece offer excellent tonal balance. With 8 strings, this standard A-style mandolin is versatile for various musical styles. A simple carry bag is included for portability.
